text: Today a new warranty claim has no automatic path to the right team -- someone has to read it and decide West or East by hand. This lesson plans the fix.
A Record-Triggered Flow fires the moment a claim is created, looks up the related Account, and reads that customer's region.
The Flow sets Region__c to match, then reassigns ownership to the right queue -- West_Service_Queue or East_Service_Queue -- so any rep on that team can pick it up.
This is the approach only. The actual Flow elements get built screen by screen once the claim object itself exists.
Next: planning the reports Service leadership needs, and the rollout plan for 150 users.
